notes: οἱ ἀπειθήσαντες Ἰουδαῖοι is decided by rule 31's test: the article governs an expressed head noun, so it takes the English determiner and the participle carries the supplied relativizer and copula (that were disobedient).
ἐκάκωσαν → made them evil affected heads on evil, the word the corpus spends on κακ-; heading on affected remains defensible and is named in the unit's note.
SBLGNT.ACT.14.2.v001 is underdetermined with a base reading compatible with the ASV, so no rule 97 note is owed.
